title: Dog Whistle
blurb: The dog whistle — high-frequency content that dogs hear clearly and most humans largely don't. Dogs can detect frequencies roughly twice as high as people can, which is why this works as a prank on two species simultaneously: every dog in range snaps to attention while the humans look around confused. It's also genuinely useful for testing whether your speakers or headphones reproduce the top of their range. Fair warning — your dog is about to become extremely interested in your phone.
origin: A high-frequency whistle tone at the edge of human hearing — dogs hear it fine.
